note: Shipped files that the engine loads by path or name with no script reference (05_asset_manifest.md check AC11). Each row says why. A file that replaces a vanilla path is never an orphan either (the manifest sets 'replaces'). Intentionally unreferenced spares go in 'spares' with a reason and an owner; an empty list means none.

bound.reason: flags are bound by country tag (checked by AC9)
the engine picks loading screens by number
cursors are bound by the engine's fixed cursor names (AC8)
font pages are bound by bitmapfont entries
map textures are named by default.map or the engine and are written by the map pipeline

achievement icons are bound by achievement id: the engine reads gfx/achievements/<id>.dds, <id>_grey.dds and <id>_not_eligible.dds for each id in common/achievements (lanes I11 and I12; the rows are in art/source/achievement_art_manifest.json, and the shipped pictures are hoi4-imagegen 0.2.1 triplets under art/source/achievement/imagegen/)
sound files are bound by sound assets (AC6)
music files are bound by music assets (AC6)
